subject: P2: Inventory API 504s during flash sale
body: Inventory API returned 504s for ~20 minutes during the flash sale. Resolved by amit.shah. Details discussed in #team-alpha huddle.

subject: P2: Checkout latency spike - session cache evictions
body: Checkout p95 latency rose to 4.2s for 35 minutes. Redis session cache evicting keys. Resolved by amit.shah.

subject: P1: Login failures after signing certificate rotation
body: Token refresh failing for ~18% of users after scheduled signing cert rotation. Resolved by deepa.nair after 50 minutes.

subject: P1: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion - orders-db
body: Incident: Connection pool on orders-db reached maximum (100 connections). Impact: 45 minutes of degraded service, ~200 failed order transactions. Root cause: New batch processor opening individual connections instead of using pool. Resolution: Deployed pgBouncer, fixed batch processor connection handling. Postmortem scheduled April 16.
